The reader supports bounded ordered nonoverlapping constructed descriptors with absolute cursor, gaps, offsets, adjacent boundaries and transactional cursor updates. The ordinary-reader mode supplies original source rate as its explicit reconstruction context. It does not claim the native hosted builder/global rate equals the file rate. Event Start uses the containing track datum; Length and Offset use the clip datum. General source-unit projection is not inferred from the reader.

Equal-rate direct reads have no resampler history. Mode0/1/2 converted audition remains separate. Rebase AVAudioEngine/worker scheduling, block sizes, completion timing and device output are application behavior, not Cubase host or DAC equivalence.
